purpose: Resolve the complete Bundler dependency graph before admitting Ruby/Bundler/Rails into the QIK-VRT runtime contract.
bootstrap_boundary: This isolated branch is a dependency-resolution carrier only. ruby/setup-ruby and Bundler success are not QIK-VRT runtime admission, P2, review, Main adoption, deployment or EFFECT_ACK evidence.
expected_output: An Actions artifact containing the exact input Gemfile and Bundler-generated Gemfile.lock after both supplied Ruby/Rails tests pass.
successor_rule: Download and inspect the generated lock. Only then create a new PR #1095 successor that registers Ruby/Bundler/Rails in TOOLCHAIN.lock.tsv and CACHE_REGISTRY.json, regenerates CACHE_COVERAGE.json, integrates the tests into make test, and reruns exact-successor P2 from zero.
